gpu-agent: Alert: ECC corrected error rate spike detected on us-west-2-gpu-pool at 1799998888
sasha: saw the alert, nodes reporting high corrected ECC counts. link: https://metrics/redwood/gpu#us-west-2
maria: can you paste the top nodes and raw `nvidia-smi` output?
lee: here's quick dump from node gpu-node-12:
```
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.total,memory.used,ecc.errors.corrected.volatile,ecc.errors.uncorrected.volatile --format=csv
0, 24576 MiB, 4 MiB, 72, 0
1, 24576 MiB, 46 MiB, 3, 0
```
jonathan: thanks. node12 has 72 corrected ECC volatile in recent window. any uncorrected?
lee: none in last 24h on that node. but multiple nodes with 20-80 corrected.
sasha: FYI Xid 13s are also showing in kernel logs intermittently:
```
[ 1234.56789] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, Graphics Exception
```
maria: we need to decide thresholds and whether to enable automatic drain. my proposal:
- uncorrectable ECC > 0 -> immediate cordon + drain
- corrected ECC: if corrected_count >= 100 within 10m OR corrected_rate > 15/s -> mark for automated drain
- add a 15m evaluation window and re-check to avoid flapping
sasha: sounds reasonable but 100 may be high; suggest conservative default 60/10m for hosted pools, 120/10m for dedicated GPU reserved pools.
lee: also want to avoid draining during peak serving in us-west-2; we should gate auto-drain with capacity buffer >= 20% free GPUs.
jonathan: agree. implement policy: only auto-drain if cluster available_capacity_pct >= 20 OR autoscale has room to spin up spare nodes.
maria: playbook draft for manual + auto drain:
1) Detection (gpu-agent webhook)
2) Auto-check: run `ssh node && sudo nvidia-smi --query-ecc ...`
3) If uncorrectable -> immediate cordon + `kubectl drain node/<node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
4) If corrected above threshold -> tag node `ecc:review` and wait 15m. If still above threshold and capacity OK -> auto-drain as above.
5) After drain, create ticket with label `hw:gpu-ecc` and schedule RA replacement; set node to `no-schedule` until replaced.
6) If multiple nodes in same rack show similar spikes -> escalate and stop auto-drain for that pool (possible power/PCI bus issue).
jonathan: implementation notes: we'll add a rate-limiter in the agent to cap drains to 1 node per 10m per-pool. add metric `gpu_auto_drains` and tag reasons.
oncall-bot: @sasha please acknowledge. :bell:
sasha: ack. I'll monitor and iterate thresholds for 24h.
maria: decision: enable conservative auto-drain on us-west-2-gpu-pool with thresholds: uncorrectable>0 immediate; corrected >= 80/10m -> drain, capacity gate 20%, rate-limit 1/10m. manual playbook link: https://confluence.redwood/infraplaybooks/gpu-ecc
lee: I'll push the agent change to staging and post logs here when up.
jonathan: adding a quick alert tweak: change severity from P3->P2 for uncorrectable, keep corrected at P3.
sasha: thanks all. if anyone sees flapping, revert auto-drain and we will run manual triage.
gpu-agent: Scheduled check for affected nodes every 5m, will post summary to #eng-infra.
